name: ETM AI
description: Optional AI submodule for Enhanced Taxonomy Manager: generate child terms, suggest placement, find semantic duplicates, auto-describe, health analysis, restructure, map to industry templates, chat commander, natural-language search, auto-tag and relationship mapping via the Drupal AI module.
project_description: ETM AI is the optional AI engine for Enhanced Taxonomy Manager. It plugs into the Drupal AI module's provider abstraction (any configured chat provider/model) and adds taxonomy-specific operations directly into the ETM tree view: generate child terms for a node, suggest the best parent for a new term, find semantic (not just string) duplicates, auto-write scope-note descriptions, run an AI health audit, propose and preview a full restructure plan, map a vocabulary onto a bundled industry-standard template (Schema.org, IAB, UNSPSC, GS1 GPC, Google product, education OER, restaurant), chat with a taxonomy assistant that returns actionable operations, extract a taxonomy from a URL or pasted text, run a natural-language semantic search, auto-tag content against the vocabulary, and map SKOS-style relationships between terms. Requires the enhanced_taxonomy_manager module and the ai module; enabled separately from the parent.
